note: Nothing custom is deployed. Veltrio's Send flow uses the official USDC contract. contracts/Veltrio.sol is source only and is not deployed or connected to the app. After you deploy it yourself, add an entry such as "Veltrio": { "address": "0x...", "deployTx": "0x...", "verified": false }. Never put the USDC address here: it lives in src/config/network.ts.
